A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PCG research. Their complete main text and Appendices A-C, including equations, tables, and figures, support reliable comparison despite bibliography repagination.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B report original counterfactual and interpolation experiments on AFHQ, FFHQ, and PlantVillage, including baseline comparisons, sensitivity analyses, and runtime measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains these original quantitative and qualitative experiments in Section 4 and Appendix B, including the benchmark, ablation, and scalability results.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same robust-feature pullback metric, two-phase path optimization, classification objective, and endpoint re-anchoring. No algorithmic or architectural change is documented.

E1.justification: Both versions retain AFHQ, FFHQ, and PlantVillage evaluations and CelebA training for attribute classifiers. The interpolation, binary and multiclass counterfactual, and other test scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: The comparator sets match: REVISE, VSGD, RSGD, and RSGD-C in the main benchmark tables, plus the same interpolation comparators and VSGD with a robust classifier in Appendix B.

E3.justification: The reported metrics, 200/300-step optimization phases, baseline tuning protocol, model configurations, and path-length and resolution settings remain unchanged in Sections 3-4 and Appendices A-B.

E4.justification: Appendix B retains the same initialization sensitivity, runtime/scaling, classifier-loss weight, path-smoothness, backbone/layer, and classifier analyses. No ablation or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: The existing uncertainty reporting is unchanged, including the plus/minus entries in Tables 1 and 6 and Table 5's mean and standard deviation summaries with 15 target initializations per input. No run-count or statistical-reporting changes appear.

E6.justification: Numerical entries and qualitative results match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 2 reports PCG FID 8.3, R-FID 9.1, and a 95% flip rate in both versions; the embedded figures are also identical.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, pullback and energy derivations, and appendix metric formulations are unchanged. The added citation in Appendix A.4 introduces no new assumption, mathematical result, or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about robust perceptual geodesics, semantically faithful counterfactuals, and revealing baseline failure modes through robust evaluation.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations and interpretations remain unchanged, as do Appendix C's limitations concerning generator quality, robustness domains, path discretization, and vision-only experiments. Appendix A.4 adds a citation without revising its explanation.

D1.justification: Implementation details and hyperparameters in Appendix A, hardware and runtime information in Appendix B, and the code-access link in Section 4 are unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds Zaher et al. (2024), 'Manifold integrated gradients: Riemannian geometry for feature attribution,' to Appendix A.4's supporting citations and the bibliography. Research positioning and novelty claims otherwise remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds Profenso to Maciej Trzaskowski's affiliations and states in the acknowledgments that he is its Managing Director and the work was conducted independently of Profenso. Apart from these additions, the citation, and the version stamp, wording and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 colors citations and URLs blue and internal cross-references red, updates the affiliation block, and reflows the bibliography onto an additional mostly empty page. The 13 figures and 13 tables retain their content and structure.

improvement.justification: The added Profenso affiliation and explicit disclosure of Trzaskowski's role and the work's independence provide a modest transparency improvement. The citation and visible link styling also aid attribution and navigation. Scientific evidence remains unchanged, while the additional bibliography page slightly reduces compactness.
